backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object } — NEW in this refactor. The prior contract returned flat payloads; every service function in domain-configuration/common and domain-configuration/documents now calls a local unwrap() helper (defensive: no-op if a response isn't actually wrapped) to strip this envelope so consumer code keeps reading flat fields (job_id, rows, categories, ...).
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> — injected globally by src/proxy.js + src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route.

endpoints.name: getDocsContext
openIssues: AMBIGUITY (user-resolved 2026-07-14): the pasted doc contained two contradicting query-param examples for this endpoint — the literal request URL + response body use upload_batch_id/pipeline_job_id, while a separate illustrative line elsewhere in the same row used batch_id/doc_types (matching an auto-generated param summary). User decision: trust the literal URL+response (upload_batch_id/pipeline_job_id) since the response JSON itself echoes back the key 'upload_batch_id'. doc_types/files params dropped entirely (not present in the new contract).

RESPONSE SHAPE CHANGE (user-resolved 2026-07-14): backend now returns a flat rows[] array (each row tagged with a category field) instead of the previous rows_by_category/categories grouped shape. User decision: group by category inside documentsService.js's getDocsContext so useDocsFormState.js/DocsReviewView.jsx need zero changes.
